label: Chapter 17 — Codex III
text: 1. From the tree, [in the shape] of an eagle, she instructed [them] to eat of knowledge, [so that they could] recall their perfection, [because] both [had] fallen into [ignorance]. 2. Ialtabaoth now noticed [that] they had withdrawn from him, [and he cursed them]. Moreover, he added concerning the [woman], ‘Your husband will rule over you,’ 4. [because he does] not know the mystery that [transpired] ⟦page 31⟧ through the sacred decree from on high. They, however, feared to curse him, and to expose his ignorance to his angels, and he expelled them from paradise, and clothed them in dark gloom. 5. He then beheld the virgin standing near Adam. Yaldabaoth was full of ignorance, and he desired to raise up a seed from her, 6. [and] he polluted her and begot the [first] child, and similarly the [second]: 7. Yavai, the bear-face, and Eloim, [the cat-face]. 8. The one is just, but [the other one] is unjust. [Eloim] is the just one, Yavai is the [unjust one]. 9. The just one he placed over fire and [wind], but the unjust one over earth and [water]. These are called Abel and Cain [by] all generations of men. 10. Until today [sexual intercourse] has continued and endured [owing to] the chief archon, and inside Adam he planted sexual lust, ⟦page 32⟧ so that by means of this this essence they gave birth to their copy through their false spirit. 11. He placed the two archons over principalities, so that they would rule over the tomb. 12. He knew his own lawlessness, and he begot Seth according to the race on high among the aeons. 13. They similarly dispatched to the mother her own spirit, 14. to rouse those who resemble it, according to the simulacrum of the perfection, and to bring all of [them] out of oblivion and the evil [of the] tomb, 15. and in this way they remained for a time while she toiled [for her] seed, so that, when the holy Spirit [comes forth from the] great aeons, he can rectify their defects for [the arranging] of the aeon, so that [it can] become a sacred Fullness, and that, consequently, they will not be defective.”

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 18 — Codex II
text: 1. I also asked the savior: “Lord, will then all the souls be conducted safely into the pure light?” 2. He answered and said to me: “Great things have arisen in your mind, because it is difficult to explain them to others, with the exception of those who are from the unmoving race. 3. Those on whom the Spirit of life will alight, and whom he will empower, they will be saved and become perfect, and they will be deserving of the Greatness, and in that place, they will be made clean of all evil, as well as participation in evil. 4. Therefore, because they possess no concern other than solely indestructibility, on which they will concentrate from this time on, without wrath, or envy or jealousy, or lust and greed for anything, they will not be troubled by anything except only the condition of fleshly existence, which they will cope with by waiting expectantly for the time when they will be greeted ⟦page 26⟧ by the receivers. 5. These kind, then, are deserving of the indestructible, eternal life, and the election, because they withstand all and endure all, so that they can complete the good and inherit eternal life.” 6. I asked him: “Lord, the souls of those who will not have performed these works, on whom the power ‹and› Spirit of life had descended.” 7. “They will be saved despite this, and they will reform, because the power will descend on all people, because apart from it no one can endure. 8. However, after being born, then, as the Spirit of life increases, and the power arrives and strengthens that soul, no one will be able to lead it astray with evil deeds. 9. However, those on whom the false spirit descends are dragged by him, and are led astray.” 10. I, however, asked: “Lord, when their souls have departed from their flesh, where will they go?” 11. He, however, grinned and said to me: “The soul, in which the power will grow stronger than the vile spirit — because it is strong and runs away from evil — even by the intervention of the indestructible one, it will be saved and brought up to the repose of the aeons.” 12. I, however, asked: “Lord, but those who were unaware of the one to whom they belong, where will their souls dwell?” 13. He then said to me: “In those, when the vile spirit ⟦page 27⟧ increased in strength, they went astray; and it weighs down the soul and drags it to evil deeds, and he throws it down into oblivion, and after it departs, it is delivered over to the authorities who originated through the archon, and they fetter it with chains, and throw it into prison, and accompany it until it rouses from oblivion and obtains knowledge, and if in this way it is perfected, it will be saved.” 14. I, however, asked: “Lord, how can the soul grow smaller and return into the natural state of its mother or into the man?” 15. He then rejoiced when I had asked him this, and he said to me: “Truly, you are blessed, because you have come to understand that such a soul will be made to succeed another, in whom the Spirit of life dwells. 16. It will be saved through him. 17. It will not be thrown again into another flesh.” 18. I also asked: “Lord, these who also did know, but who have turned away, where will their souls go?” 19. Then he said to me: “They will be brought to that place where the angels of destitution go, the place with no repentance, and they will be detained for the day when those who have blasphemed the Spirit will be tormented, and they will be punished with an age-long punishment.”

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 18 — Berlin Codex
text: 1. I, however, asked: “Christ, will the souls of everyone continue living in the pure light?” 2. He said to me: “You have opened up a contemplation of great things of the kind that are difficult to explain to others, with the exception ⟦page 65⟧ of those who originate from that unmoving race. 3. Those on whom the Spirit of life is soon to alight, after they have joined together with the power, they will be saved, they will become perfect, and they will deserve to enter these great lights, because there they will deserve to be purified of all evil, and the temptations of evil, 4. given that they devote themselves to nothing else but this indestructible assembly, and they will certainly fix their attention on it, without wrath, or envy, or fear, or lust, or pleasure. They are not troubled by any of these, not even by a single one of them, except only the flesh, ⟦page 66⟧ while they put it to use, looking forward with expectation to when they will be brought forth and received by those who receive 5. into the excellence of eternal, indestructible life and the election, withstanding all, and enduring all, so that they will finish the contest and inherit eternal life.” 6. I asked: “Christ, if they will not have performed these things, what will the souls do to be similarly saved, those into whom the power and the Spirit of life had entered?” 7. He said to me: ⟦page 67⟧ “Those into whom that spirit enters will in any scenario live and will be delivered out of evil, because the power enters into everyone, because without it they would be unable to stand. 8. However, after it is born, the Spirit of life will then be carried to it. In this way, when this strong Spirit of life has arrived, it strengthens the power, that is, the soul, and it strays not into evil. 9. However, those into whom the false spirit enter‹s are› compelled by him and ‹are› led astray.” 10. I, however, asked: “Christ, when their souls ⟦page 68⟧ have departed from their flesh, where will they go?” 11. He, however, grinned and said: “To a place of the soul, which is the power that has grown far more excellent than the false spirit. This is strong, and it runs away from evil deeds, and by means of the indestructible providential care, it will be saved and brought up to the repose of the aeons.” 12. I, however, asked: “Christ, those who did not know the All, what are their souls, or where will they go?” 13. He said to me: “Over these a false spirit increased in strength ⟦page 69⟧ when they faltered, and in this way he weighs down their soul, compels it to evil deeds, and throws it into oblivion. In this way, after it becomes naked, he delivers it over to the authorities who came into existence from the archon. They once again throw them into fetters and accompany them until they are rescued from oblivion, and it obtains knowledge, and in this way is perfected and saved.” 14. I, however, asked: “Christ, how does the soul grow smaller and smaller and return into the natural state of the mother or into the man?” 15. He, however, rejoiced when I had asked him this, and he said: ⟦page 70⟧ “Blessed are you for understanding. For this cause, then, they are given over to the other, in whom dwells the Spirit of life. 16. By means of following and obeying through him, it will be saved. 17. In fact, it will no longer enter into flesh.” 18. I asked him: “Christ, but those who did know, but who have turned away, where will their souls go?” 19. He said to me: “They will go to the place where the angels of destitution will retreat, to whom repentance does not come. They will be detained for the day when all those who have blasphemed the holy Spirit will be punished. They will be ⟦page 71⟧ tormented with an age-long punishment.”

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 18 — Codex III
text: 1. [I] then asked: “Lord, will the [souls] of everyone escape to [the pure] light?” 2. He said [to me]: “You have opened up a contemplation of [great] ⟦page 33⟧ things that are difficult to explain to others, with the exception of those who originate from the unmoving race. 3. Those whom the Spirit of life enters and joins itself with the power will be saved, perfect, and they will deserve these great lights, because there they will be purified of all evil, and of the chains of evil, 4. because they [devote themselves] to nothing else but the indestructible assembly, and fix their attention on it from this time forward, without wrath or envy, without jealousy, or lust, or pleasure. [By] none of these are they troubled, [except] the condition of existing [in the flesh] while they put it to use, looking forward with expectation to [the hour] when they will be brought forth and received [by] those who receive 5. [into] the excellence of eternal life [and the] election, withstanding all, and [enduring] all, so that they will [finish] the contest and inherit eternal life.” 6. I, however, [asked] him: “Lord, those who will not have [performed] these things, where will their souls be, ⟦page 34⟧ or where will those go whom the Spirit of life and the power had entered? Will they be saved, or not?” 7. He said to me: “Those into whom the Spirit of life enters will in any scenario be saved. These run away from evil, because the power enters into everyone, because apart from it [they] would be unable to stand. 8. After the person is born, then the [Spirit] of life is brought before the false spirits. When the Spirit of life comes, then, because it is strong, it makes strong [the soul], which is the power, and [it] strays [not] into evil. 9. [The one] into whom [the] false spirit [enters] is compelled [by it], and goes astray.” 10. I, however, asked: “Lord, when [these] souls have departed from their flesh, where [will they go]?” 11. He, however, grinned and said: “If the soul, which is the power, [grows stronger] than the false spirit — [because] what runs away [from] evil is strong — it will be saved by means of the ⟦page 35⟧ indestructible providential care, and will be brought to the repose of the aeons.” 12. I, however, asked: “Lord, those who did not know at all, what are their souls, or where will they go?” 13. He said to me: “These are the ones the false spirit has weighed down when they faltered, and in this way their soul was weighed down, compelled to evil deeds and reduced to oblivion, and in this way, after being [stripped] of the body, they are delivered over to the authorities who came into existence [through] the archon. [They] once again [throw] them into limbs and accompany them until they are [saved from] evil and [oblivion and obtain] knowledge. In this way [they are perfected and saved].” 14. I, however, [asked him]: “Lord, and how [does] the soul [grow small] again [so that it may be granted entrance] into the nature of the mother or [into] the man?” 15. He, however, rejoiced [when I] had asked him, and he said to me: “Blessed are you for attending closely. It is given to another, ⟦page 36⟧ in which the Spirit of life dwells. 16. It follows him, obeys through him, and is saved. 17. They will not enter flesh from that time on.” 18. I, however, asked: “Lord, those who did know, and who have turned back, where will their souls be, or to where will they retreat?” 19. He said to me: “The place to which the angels of destitution will retreat, to whom repentance does not come, and [they] will be detained for that day when all those who have blasphemed the holy Spirit with an age-long [blasphemy] will be punished by being tormented [with an] age-long punishment.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 19 — Codex II & IV
text: 1. I, however, asked: “Lord, where did the vile spirit originate?” 2. He then said to me: “The Mother-Father, who is abundant in mercy, the holy Spirit in every mode, the one who is merciful and ⟦page 28⟧ who shows compassion for all of you — that is, Reflection of Radiant Providence — he raised up the seed of the perfect race, and its intellect, and the eternal light of the Man. 3. When the chief archon became aware that they were loftier than him in the height, and that they surpass him in intellect, he then desired to grasp their objective, unaware that they surpassed him in intellect, and that he would be unable to grasp them. 4. He concocted a plot with his authorities, who are his powers, and together they committed adultery with Sophia; and bitter Destiny was begotten by them, the final inconstant fetter, being of a vacillating kind, and it is more durable and stronger than she with whom the gods joined (in adultery), and the angels, and the demons, and all the generations up to the present day, because from that Destiny issued forth all transgression, and injustice, and blasphemy, and the fetter of oblivion and ignorance, and every stern command with grievous transgressions, and overwhelming fears. 5. In this way also all of creation was blinded, so that they would not know God who is over all of them, and on account of the fetter of oblivion their sins were concealed, because they are fettered with measurements and times and moments, given that it is the universal overlord. 6. He then regretted everything that had transpired because of him. 7. This time he conspired to bring a flood ⟦page 29⟧ on the productions of humanity, but the greatness of the radiant Providence notified Noah, and he preached to all the seed of the children of humanity, but those who were strangers to him did not heed him. 8. It was not as Moses said, ‘They hid themselves in an ark,’ but they hid themselves in a place — not only Noah, but many other people also from the unmoving race. 9. They entered a place and concealed themselves inside a radiant cloud, and he was aware of his authority, and she who pertains to the light accompanied him. 10. She had shone on them because he had caused darkness to cover all the earth, and he concocted a plot together with his powers. 11. He dispatched his angels to the daughters of men, to take some for themselves, even to raise up seed for their pleasure, and they were at first unsuccessful. 12. When they had not succeeded, they again assembled and together concocted a plot. 13. They created a vile spirit resembling the Spirit who had descended, in order thereby to defile souls, and the angels transformed their likeness into the likeness of their mates, making them to be full of the spirit of darkness, which for them they had mixed together with evil. 14. They presented gold and silver, and a gift even of copper and iron, and objects of every kind of metal, and they led the people following them ⟦page 30⟧ into great troubles by leading them astray with a plethora of tricks. 15. They grew old without enjoying any pleasures. 16. Without discovering the truth, and without knowledge of the true God, they died, and in this way all of creation fell into an age-long slavery, lasting from the foundation of the world until now. 17. They further selected women and begot children from the darkness, according to the likeness of their (own) spirit, and they shut up their hearts, and they hardened themselves by means of the hardness of the vile spirit, (even) until now.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 19 — Berlin Codex
text: 1. I, however, asked: “Christ, where did the false spirit originate?” 2. He said to me: “When the abundantly merciful mother, together with the merciful holy Spirit, the one who pitied us — that is, Reflection of Light, together with her offspring, — he is the one who raised it in the intellect of the people of the race of this Perfect Man of eternal light. 3. The chief archon became aware that they were loftier than him in the height of their wisdom, and he desired to seize their objective, because he was ignorant, unaware ⟦page 72⟧ that they were wiser than he. 4. He concocted a plot with his powers, and they begot Destiny, and fettered with measurements and times and moments the gods of the heavens, and angels, and demons, and humans, so that all of them would be in its fetter, given that (Destiny) is the universal overlord, a wicked and perverted notion. He then regretted everything that had transpired because of him. 7. He conspired to bring a flood on all the offspring of humanity but the greatness of Providence, being Reflection of Light, ⟦page 73⟧ notified Noah, and he preached to people, but they did not believe him. 8. It was not as Moses said, ‘He hid himself in an ark,’ but she protected him in a place — not only Noah, but people of the unmoving race. 9. They entered a place and protected themselves with a radiant cloud, and he became aware of his lordship and of those who were with him 10. inside the light that shone on them, because darkness was descending over everything on the earth. He concocted a plot together with his ⟦page 74⟧ angels. 11. They dispatched their angels to the daughters of men, so that from them they could raise up offspring for their pleasure, and they were at first unsuccessful. 12. They all reached an agreement on a plot 13. to create the false spirit, because they recalled the Spirit who had descended, and the angels transformed ‹their› likeness into the likeness ‹of their husbands›, because being their husbands, they filled them with spirit that mixed together with them inside the darkness that originates from evil. 14. They presented them with gold and silver and gifts, even of metals of copper and iron, even of all kinds, ⟦page 75⟧ and they led them into temptation so that they would not be able to remember their unwavering Providence. 17. They selected them and begot children out of the darkness with their false spirit. He shut up their hearts and they grew hard with the hardness of the false spirit, (even) until now.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 19 — Codex III
text: 1. [I, however], asked: “Lord, [where did] the false spirit originate?” 2. He then said: “In the beginning [...], when in the [holy] Spirit I gazed into the one who is abundant in her [mercy, together with the] holy Spirit who pitied [us], who is Reflection of Light, [who dwelt] with her seed — she [raised it in] the intellect of the people of the unmoving [race] of the [radiant] Perfect [Man]. 3. ⟦page 37⟧ Then the chief archon became aware, then, that they were loftier than him [in] the height of their wisdom, and he desired to seize their objective, because he was ignorant, unaware that they were wiser than he. 4. He concocted [a] plot and begot Destiny. [He fettered] with measurements and times and moments the gods of the heavens, and angels, and demons, [and] humans, so that all of them would [be] in its fetter, and so that it would be [the universal overlord], a wicked and perverted notion, and he regretted what had transpired because of [him]. 7. [He] conspired to bring a [flood] on [all] the [offspring] of humanity, but the [greatness] of Providence resulted in a thought which is Reflection, and she appeared to [Noah. He] preached to people, (but) they did not [believe] him. 8. It was not as Moses said, ‘They hid in an [ark],’ but it was in a place where they protected themselves — ⟦page 38⟧ not only Noah, but also other people of the unmoving race. 9. They entered a place and protected themselves with a radiant cloud, and they became aware of the lordship above and those who were with him, 10. because the light shone on them, because [darkness] was descending over everyone on the earth. He concocted a [plot] together with his angels. 11. He dispatched his angels to the [daughters] of men, so that they [could raise up] offspring from them, in this way producing pleasure for themselves, and they were at first unsuccessful; 12 and [when they were unsuccessful], they [together concocted a plot] 13. to create [the false spirit] mimicking [the Spirit] who had descended. Their [angels] transformed their likeness [into] the likeness of their husbands [so as to fill] them with the spirit that dwelt in [themselves], full of the darkness that originates from evil. 14. They presented them with gold [and] silver and gifts, even [objects] ⟦page 39⟧ [made of copper] and iron metal, and everything of that kind, and they [directed] them into amusements, [so that] they would not be able to remember their unwavering Providence, 17. and they selected [them] and begot children out of [the] darkness with their false spirit, and they shut up their hearts and became hard with the hardness of [their] false spirit, (even) until [now].

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 20 — Codex II & Codex IV
text: 1. Therefore, I, the perfect Providence of the all, transformed myself into my (own) seed, because I was the first to exist, traveling all paths, because I am the wealth of the light. 2. I am the remembrance of the Fullness, but I entered into the realm of darkness, and I persevered until I entered the middle of the prison, and the foundations of chaos trembled, and I hid myself away from them because of their evil, and they failed to recognize me. 3. I again returned a second time, and I traveled around. 4. I issued forth from those who are of the light, which I am, being the remembrance of Providence. 5. I entered into the middle of the darkness and into the interior of Hades, given that I was looking after my mission, and the foundations of Chaos trembled, seeking to collapse on those who dwell in Chaos, and to destroy them, and again I hastened upward to my light-root, so that they would not be destroyed before the time. 6. Even for a third time I went forth, I being the light that is inside the light, I being the remembrance of Providence, to enter into the middle of the darkness and the interior ⟦page 31⟧ of Hades, and I filled my face with the light of the consummation of their aeon, and I entered into the middle of their prison, namely, the prison ‹of› the body, and I said, ‘He who hears, let him rise up from the deep slumber,’ and he wept and the tears flowed. 7. He wiped away bitter tears off himself, and he said: ‘Who is calling my name, and from where has this hope come to me, while I am in the fetters of the prison?’ 8. I also said: ‘I am the Providence of the pure light. 9. I am the thought of the virginal Spirit who lifts you up to the praiseworthy place. 10. Rise up and remember that you are the one who gave heed, and follow your root, which I am, the Merciful One, and protect yourself from the angels of destitution and from the demons of Chaos, and from all those who trap you, and watch out for the deep slumber and the confinement in the interior of Hades.’ 11. I also lifted him up and sealed him with the light of the water of five seals, so that Death would not overpower him from this time on, and lo, I will now ascend to the perfect aeon.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 20 — Berlin Codex
text: 11. Therefore, the blessed one, that is, the Mother-Father, abundant in mercy, is taking shape inside her seed. I first ascended to this perfect aeon.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 20 — Codex III
text: 11. Therefore, the blessed Mother-[Father], who is abundant in her mercy, is taking shape with her seed. I first [ascended] to the perfect aeon.

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 21 — Codex II & Codex IV
text: 1. In your hearing I have finished everything for your sake, but I have said everything to you so that you may write them down and distribute them in secret to your companion spirits, because this is the mystery of the unmoving race.” 2. The savior also entrusted these sayings to him so that he would write them down and keep them locked away, and he said to him: “Cursed be any who will trade these sayings for a gift, either of food, or of drink, or of garments, or of any other thing like these.” ⟦page 32⟧ 3. These sayings were also entrusted to him in a mystery, and suddenly he vanished from him, and he departed to his companion disciples and informed them about what the savior had said to him. Jesus Christ. Amen. The Secret Writing According to John

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 21 — Berlin Codex
text: 1. I, however, speak these things to you, so that you may write them down and distribute them in secret to your companion spirits, because this is the mystery of the unmoving race. ⟦page 76⟧ The Mother, however, came another time in front of me. These are now the things she performed in the world: she rectified her seed. 2. I will instruct all of you concerning what will come to pass, because surely I offered these things to you to be written down and be kept secure.” He then said to me: “Cursed be any who will trade these sayings for a gift, either of food, or of drink, or of garments, or of any other thing like these.” 3. He entrusted this mystery to him, and he immediately vanished from him, and he ⟦page 77⟧ departed to his companion disciples and began informing them about what had ‹been› spoken to him by the savior. The Secret Writing According to John

title: The Secret Book of John
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 21 — Codex III
text: 1. [I, however, have spoken] these things to you, so that you may write [them] down [and distribute them in secret] to your companion spirits, [because this] is the mystery [of the] unmoving [race]. This Mother had come [another time in front of me]. [Every]thing she performed in the world, she was [rectifying] the defect. 2. I will [now instruct ‹you›] further concerning what is to come, because surely [I have offered you these things] to write them down and to preserve them [securely]. He then said to me: “[Cursed] be all who will trade these sayings ⟦page 40⟧ for a gift, either of silver or [gold], either for drink or for food, or for garments or for any other thing like these.” 3. He entrusted this mystery to him, and he immediately vanished from him. [He stood] in front of his companion disciples, and began to speak with them [concerning the] things the savior had spoken to him. The Secret Writing According to John

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 1
text: 1. ⟦page 86⟧ Concerning the substance of the authorities (from which they were made). 2. By the spirit of the Father of truth, the great apostle mentioned the authorities of darkness, and informed us that “our battle is not against flesh and [blood], but against the cosmic authorities and the spirits of evil.” 3. I have sent you this writing because you inquired concerning the substance of the authorities (from which they were made). 4. Their leader is blind. [On account of his] power, ignorance, and pride, he declared in his [power]: “I am God; there is no other [except me].” 5. When he uttered this, he sinned against [the All]. 6. This bragging ascended to indestructability, ⟦page 87⟧ 7. and a voice responded from indestructability, and said: “You are in error, Samael,” which means “blind god,” his thoughts being blind. 8. He vented his power, namely, the blasphemy he had uttered, and he followed it down into Chaos and to his mother, the Abyss, prompted by Pistis Sophia. 9. She set up each one of his offspring in agreement with its power, according to the likeness of the lofty eternal aeons, because what is seen originated from what is unseen. 10. Indestructability peered downward into the place of the waters. Her image appeared as a reflection on the waters, and the authorities of darkness grew enamored with her. 11. They, however, were unable to hold onto the image that had appeared to them on the waters, because they were feeble. 12. And what is merely soulish is unable to hold onto what is spiritual, because the authorities originated from below, while the image of indestructability originated from above. 13. Consequently, indestructability peered downward into that place, in order that by the will of the Father she could unite all of them with the light.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 2
text: 1. The archons schemed, and said: “Come, let us create a man to be soil of the earth.” 2. They fashioned their creation as an entirely earthly being. 3. The archons possess bodies that are both female [and male], and their faces are faces of beasts. 4. They took [soil] from the earth and fashioned [their man] according to their own bodies and [according to the image] of God that had appeared [to them] on the water. 5. They said: “[Come], let us lay hold of the image through the form we have molded, [in order that] the image can gaze on its male counterpart [and grow enamored with it], ⟦page 88⟧ and in order that we can grasp it in the form we have molded.” 6. Being powerless, they understood not the power of God. 7. He blew into his face, and the man came to possess a soul, and he remained on the ground for several days. 8. Being powerless, the archons were unable to make him arise. 9. They continued to blow like tempestuous winds, attempting to seize hold of the image that had appeared to them on the waters, and they knew not its power. 10. All of these events transpired by the will of the Father of the All. 11. The Spirit subsequently gazed on the soulish man on the ground. 12. The Spirit came forth from the Adamic Land. 13. It descended and took up its abode inside him, and that man became a living soul, and the Spirit called his name Adam, because he was found moving on the ground. 14. A voice from indestructibility came forth to be a help to Adam.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 3
text: 1. The archons brought together all of the animals of the earth, and all of the birds of the sky, even bringing them before Adam to learn what Adam might call them, so that he could assign names to all of the birds and to all the animals. 2. The archons conveyed Adam, even placing him in the garden, so that he might tend it and guard it. 3. They ordered him, and said: “You are allowed to eat from [all] the trees in the garden, but eat not from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. 4. [Touch] it not, because on the day you eat from it, you certainly will die.” 5. [This] they [said to him], yet they understood not what [they had said] to him. 6. Instead, it was according to the will of the Father ⟦page 89⟧ that they said this in the way they did, so that Adam would (indeed) eat, and so that Adam would ‹not› think of them in the way a thoroughly material man would. 7. The archons schemed with one another, and said: “Come, let us cause a deep sleep to fall upon Adam,” so that Adam slept. 8. The deep sleep they caused to fall upon him, and which he slept, is ignorance. 9. They opened up his side, like a living woman. 10. Then they closed up his side with flesh in its place, and Adam became merely soulish. 11. The spiritual woman approached him, and she spoke with him, saying: “Arise, Adam.” 12. When he gazed on her, he said: “You have granted me life; you will be called the Mother of the living, because she is my mother. She is the physician, the woman, the one who has given birth.” 13. The authorities approached their Adam. 14. When they saw his female counterpart talking with him, they were aroused and lusted for her. 15. They said to one another: “Come, let us sow our semen into her,” and they pursued her. 16. She, however, laughed at them on account of their stupidity and blindness. 17. As they grabbed her, she became a tree, and as she placed before them a shadowy likeness of herself, they defiled it most vilely, defiling the signet of her voice. 18. And thus they brought judgment on themselves by means of the shape they had modeled in their own image.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 4
text: 1. Then the female spiritual nature arrived in the guise of the serpent, the teacher. 2. The serpent taught Adam and Eve, and said: “What did Samael [say to] you? 3. Was what he said: ‘You are allowed to eat from all trees in the garden, but do not eat from [the tree] of the knowledge of good and evil’?” 4. ⟦page 90⟧ The fleshly woman said: “He said not only ‘Eat not,’ but even ‘Touch it not, because on the day that you eat from it, you certainly will die.’” 5. The serpent, the teacher, said: “Certainly you will not die, because he said this to you motivated by jealousy. 6. On the contrary, your eyes will be opened, and you will become like gods, knowing (what is) good and evil.” 7. And the female teaching nature was removed from the serpent, and she forsook it as though it were something earthly. 8. The fleshly woman took of the tree and ate, and she gave to her husband also, and in this way they ate, these beings who were merely soulish. 9. Their blemish was revealed by their lack of knowledge. 10. They realized that they had been stripped of what is spiritual, and they took fig leaves and fastened them around their naked loins. 11. Because he was unaware of what had transpired, the leader of the archons arrived and said: “Adam, where are you?” 12. Adam said: “I heard your voice, and I became afraid, because I was naked, and so I hid.” 13. The archon said: “Why did you hide, if not because you ate from the one tree from which I forbade you to eat? 14. You ate (from it)!” 15. Adam said: “The woman you gave me [handed] me the fruit, and I ate it.” 16. And the haughty [archon] cursed the woman. 17. The woman said: “The serpent fooled me, and (so) I ate.” 18. [The archons turned] toward the serpent, and cursed its shadow, [making it] grow weak. 19. And they knew not that it was the same shape they had modeled. 20. From that time on, the serpent came under the curse of the authorities, lasting ⟦page 91⟧ until the Perfect Man came. 21. They turned to their Adam, driving him together with his wife out of the garden. 22. They possessed no blessing, because they, too, were under the curse. 23. They drove mankind into a massive confusion and a life of work, in order that their mankind might be concerned with worldly matters and have no time to be concerned with the holy Spirit.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 5
text: 1. Next, Eve then gave birth to Cain, their son, and Cain tilled the land. 2. Then Adam knew his wife. She once again became pregnant, giving birth to Abel, and Abel was a shepherd. 3. Cain brought in crops from his field, while Abel brought in an offering from among his lambs. 4. God looked favorably on the offering of Abel, but he did not accept the offerings of Cain. 5. The fleshly Cain pursued his brother Abel. 6. God said to Cain: “Where is Abel your brother?” 7. Cain answered and said: “Am I my brother’s keeper?” 8. God said to Cain: “Listen! The voice of your brother’s blood calls to me. 9. You have sinned with your mouth. 10. It will return to you. 11. Whoever kills Cain will unleash seven revenges, and you will live moaning and trembling on the earth.” 12. Adam once again [knew] his female counterpart Eve, and she became pregnant and bore [Seth] to Adam. 13. She said: “I have given birth to [another] man through God, to replace [Abel].” 14. Eve once again became pregnant and gave birth to [Norea]. 15. Eve said: “He has begotten a virgin for me in order to help many generations of humans.” 16. ⟦page 92⟧ She is the virgin whom the forces did not defile. 17. And mankind began to multiply and to progress.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 6
text: 1. The archons schemed with one another and said: “Come, let us cause a flood by our hands and annihilate all flesh, humans and beasts.” 2. When the archon of the forces came to know of their scheme, he said to Noah: “Make for yourself an ark of wood that does not rot, and hide in it, you together with your children and with the beasts and the birds of the sky, both small and large, settling it on Mount Sir.” 3. Orea then approached Noah, desirous to board the ark. 4. When he refused her, she blew on the ark so that it was devoured by fire. So a second time he made an ark.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 7
text: 1. The archons went to meet her, scheming to fool her. 2. Their leader said to her, “Your mother, Eve, approached us,” 3. but Norea turned to them, and said: “You are the archons of the darkness; cursed be you! 4. You did not know my mother, but you instead knew your own female counterpart, because I am not your offspring; I come from the world above.” 5. In his might, the haughty archon turned, and his expression became as a flaming [inferno]. 6. He was presumptuous toward her, and [said]: “You must render us sexual services, as did your mother Eve, because [...] has been delegated to me.” 7. Norea, however, in the power of [God] turned and cried with a loud voice to the Holy One, the God of the All: ⟦page 93⟧ “Rescue me from archons of injustice and save me immediately from their hands!” 8. An angel descended from heaven and said to her: “Why do you invoke God? 9. Why are you so presumptuous toward the holy Spirit?” 10. Norea said, “Who are you?” 11. (Meanwhile), the archons of injustice had withdrawn from her. 12. The angel said: “It is I, Eleleth, the great angel Wisdom, who stands in front of the holy Spirit. 13. I have been sent to speak with you, and to save you from the hand of those who are lawless, and I will instruct you concerning your root.” 14. Regarding that angel, I am unable to speak of his power. 15. His appearance resembles fine gold, and his garment resembles snow. 16. My mouth is truly unable to speak of his power and the appearance of his face. 17. The great angel Eleleth spoke to me, and said: “I am Wisdom, being one of the Four Lights who stand in front of the great unseen Spirit. 18. Do you (really) imagine that these archons are able to exercise (any) power over you? 19. Not one of them will be able to conquer the root of the truth, because he has appeared in the last days on account of the root of the truth, and these authorities will be confined. 20. Also, these authorities will be unable to defile you and that generation, because your abode is in indestructibility, where abides the virgin Spirit, who is superior over the authorities of chaos and over their world.”

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 8
text: 1. I said: “My Lord, instruct me concerning the [power of] these authorities. 2. [How] did they come into being, and out of what kind of substance and out of ⟦page 94⟧ what matter, and who created them and their strength?” 3. The great angel, Eleleth, who is Wisdom, said to me: “Indestructibility dwells inside infinite aeons. 4. Sophia, who is called Pistis, desired to create something independently, apart from her companion, and what she produced originated from above. 5. There is a veil between the upper world and the aeons below, and a shadow came into being under the veil, and the shadow became matter, and the shadow fell onto a separate place. 6. What she had produced developed into something material resembling an aborted fetus, and its shape was molded out of the shadow, and it became a haughty beast resembling a lion. 7. It was androgynous, as I previously mentioned, because it had originated from matter. 8. He opened his eyes, gazing on a vast, infinite quantity of matter, and he grew haughty, and said: ‘I am God, and nothing exists apart from me.’ 9. In saying this, he had sinned against the All, and a voice came forth from above the place of supreme rule, and said: ‘You are in error, Samael,’ meaning ‘blind god.’ 10. He said, ‘If anything else exists before me, show it to me.’ 11. Sophia immediately stretched out her finger and inserted light into matter, and she pursued it downward to the place of chaos. 12. She then returned upward to her light, darkness once again [falling on] matter. 13. This archon, being androgynous, made for himself a vast realm, an infinite expanse. 14. ⟦page 95⟧ He thought of creating offspring for himself, and he created seven offspring for himself, androgynous just like their parent. 15. He said to his offspring: ‘I am God of the All.’ 16. Zoe, the daughter of Pistis Sophia, cried out and said to him: ‘You are in error, Sakla,’ whose other name is ‘Yaldabaoth.’ 17. Zoe breathed into his face, and her breath became an angel of fire for her, and that angel bound Yaldabaoth, casting him down to Tartaros, under the abyss.

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 9
text: 1. “When Sabaoth, son of Yaldabaoth, witnessed the power of that angel, he repented and sentenced to judgment his father and Matter, his mother, whom he reviled. 2. And he sang songs of praise to Sophia above, and to her daughter Zoe. 3. Sophia and Zoe brought him up and appointed him over the seventh heaven, under the veil that divides the upper and lower (realms). 4. He is called ‘God of hosts, Sabaoth,’ because he is over the hosts of chaos, because Sophia appointed him. 5. When these events had transpired, Sabaoth made a massive four-faced chariot of cherubim for himself, and an infinity of angels to be his servants, as well as harps and lyres. 6. Sophia brought her daughter Zoe and caused her to sit at his right hand and to instruct him concerning the things of the eighth heaven. 7. And she placed the angel of wrath at his left hand. 8. [From] that day onward, [his right hand] was called ‘life,’ ⟦page 96⟧ while the left hand came to symbolize the injustice of the upper realm of the autocrat. 9. Before the time you existed, these events had transpired. 10. When Yaldabaoth saw Sabaoth in this great majesty and exalted so highly, he grew envious of him, and his envy became an androgynous entity. 11. And such was the origin of Envy, who gave birth to Death, and Death gave birth to offspring, and Death appointed each of them to be in charge of its (own) heaven. 12. And all of the heavens of the chaos were filled with their multitudes. 13. All of these events, however, transpired by the will of the Father of the All, according to the pattern of everything above, in order that the summation of chaos could be achieved. 14. Behold, I have instructed you concerning the mold of the archons, the matter in which was made manifest, as well as their parent and their world.”

title: Hypostasis of the Archons
edition: Samuel Zinner, edited by Mark M. Mattison; Other Gospels
label: Chapter 10
text: 1. I said: “My Lord, do I, too, originate from their matter?” 2. “You, as well as your offspring, originate from the Father, who existed from the beginning. 3. The souls originate from above, from indestructible light. 4. The authorities, accordingly, are unable to go near them, on account of the spirit of the truth that is inside them, and everyone who knows this path of the truth will be deathless among mortal humans. 5. That seed, however, will not as yet become known. 6. It will become known after three ages, and it will (then) liberate them from the bondage of the error of the authorities.” 7. I said: “My Lord, how much longer until it comes to pass?” 8. He said to me: “Until the moment the True Man in a moldable substance reveals [the spirit of] truth the Father has sent. 9. ⟦page 97⟧ He will then instruct them concerning all things, anointing them with the oil of eternal life, bestowed on him from the kingless generation. 10. They will then be liberated from blind thought, and they will tread on death, which originates from the authorities, and they will ascend to the infinite light where this seed dwells. 11. The authorities then will give up their times, and their angels will weep because of their destruction, and their demons will grieve because of their death. 12. Then all the sons of light will truly know the truth, as well as their root and the Father of the All, and the holy Spirit. 13. All of them will proclaim with a single voice: ‘The truth of the Father is just, the Son reigns over the All.’ 14. And from everyone (will come the proclamation): ‘Forever and ever, holy, holy, holy! Amen.’”
